title: Sum along an axis
summary: An axis is one direction through an array. For this two-dimensional table, axis 0 combines rows to produce a total for each column.
introduction: An axis is one direction through an array. For this two-dimensional table, axis 0 combines rows to produce a total for each column. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: An axis is one direction through an array. For this two-dimensional table, axis 0 combines rows to produce a total for each column.

blocks.code:
import numpy as np

grid = np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
print(grid.sum(axis=0).tolist())
blocks.title: Sum along an axis

blocks.text: The output is [4, 6]. Column one adds 1 and 3; column two adds 2 and 4.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Use axis=1 to total each row.
